The parent's first ``codify()`` call walks the DAG, spawns a
Mission row per ``is_sub_mission: true`` node, and then raises

post.description:
Dev endpoint: write a stub CodificationRecord for a child
mission spawned by a parent's sub-mission node.

Spec §1.1 / §12.5 — recursive decomposition requires the child
mission to run its own complete Stage 1-6 legislative pipeline
before its CodificationRecord exists. The Streamlit demo
bypasses that for child missions to keep the click-through
manageable: instead of recursing through Steps 1-8 again for
every child, this endpoint synthesises a placeholder
CodificationRecord directly so the parent's
``_resolve_sub_missions`` gate sees the child as 'codified'
and lets the parent codify advance.

The synthesised record carries a clearly-labelled
``[demo-stub]`` canonical_spec, a deterministic dag_hash, and
``deployment_verified='verified'`` so downstream queries that
check 'is this fully codified' return True. Marked as a demo
stub in the response so the demo UI can show a 'this would be
a full Stage 1-6 pipeline in production' caption.

Request body: {"child_mission_id": "<uuid>"}

Run the authentic §1 SP-2 six-stage legislative pipeline for a
child mission end-to-end.

Composes the real service methods — `TeamService.create_team` +
`respond_to_invite`, `ProposalService.submit_proposal`,
`DeliberationService.open_evaluate_session` /
`submit_evaluation` / `close_session` / `generate_shortlist` /
`open_rank_session` / `submit_vote` / `tally_votes`,
`CodificationService.review_proposal` / `codify` /
`sign_codification` / `verify_deployment` — so every stage hits
real backend code, not a stub.

Returns a per-stage summary + artifact ids so the demo UI can
show the audience the full SP-2 pipeline firing at the child
layer. Idempotent: if the child is already codified, returns
the existing record.

Request body: {"child_mission_id": "<uuid>"}

Dev endpoint: populate the Adjudication Panel's pending
queue with synthetic data so operators can test the Override
Panel without walking through the full Pillar 1 → Pillar 2
pipeline.

Three scenarios (body: `{"scenario": "freeze" | "emergency_stop" |
"sanction"}`):

* ``freeze`` — creates one synthetic CollaborationNodeState in
  FROZEN status + a NodeGuardCheck with σ=2.4 tool-overrun reason
  so the operator can pick one of four §4.5 recovery paths.
* ``emergency_stop`` — creates a contract with 3 cascade-frozen
  nodes (freeze_reason prefixed "mission_emergency_stop:"),
  mirroring the §4.5 auto-escalation signal the panel detects.
* ``sanction`` — creates one active AgentSanction row so the
  sanctions counter lights up. Requires an existing
  DelegateAgent — picks the first active one if available.

All synthetic rows are labelled "[demo-scenario]" in their
text fields so audits can tell them apart from real state.
Idempotently drive one demo mission's stored payout signature.

Deliberation Stage 2a — Regulator clerk aggregates per-agent
evidence and commits it to a Merkle root.

Runs on an EVALUATE session; must happen before the preliminary
vote so committee members can consult the dossiers before casting
a first-impression ballot.

Per-agent evidence includes aggregated task-completion counts,
PoP verification pass/fail counts, Guardian warning counts, and

get.description: List every anchored evidence dossier for a session.

Read the proposal's live on-chain state via SDK §6.4.

Looks up the off-chain ``DeliberationProposal`` by its UUID,
pulls ``chain_proposal_id`` (set when seam §6.1 fired at
qualification time), then calls
``ac.legislative.get_proposal_status(...)`` to fetch the live
on-chain struct (proposer, dag_merkle_root, stage, sponsors,
completed, expired).

Three response shapes:

* Proposal not found → 404.
* Proposal exists off-chain only (chain_proposal_id is NULL):
  ``{anchored: False, off_chain: {...}, on_chain: None}``.
* Anchored on chain: ``{anchored: True, verification_status: "verified",
  off_chain: {...}, on_chain: {...}, mode: "real" | "mock"}``.
* Chain readback unavailable: ``{anchored: None,
  verification_status: "unavailable", off_chain: {...}, on_chain: None}``.

The ``on_chain`` block is the chain's authoritative view — used
by the demo to *prove* the chain accepted what we sent rather
than relying on the tx_hash we got back at submit time.

get.description:
Compute the Deliberation Shift Index for a mission.

Spec §6.2 — DSI = (1/|A|) · Σ d_τ(σ_pre_i, σ_final_i). Pulls the
latest EVALUATE session's preliminary ballots and the latest RANK
session's final ballots, pairs them per agent, and averages the
normalised Kendall τ distance. Returns ``available: false`` when
one of the two ballot rounds has no rows yet.

Run structural Coordination Detection for a mission.

Spec §9.12 / §A.4 hypothesis H2h — compares pairwise Kendall τ
concordance and Jaccard top-k overlap between each agent's
straw-poll ballot (Stage 2b) and final ballot (Stage 3). Pairs
that are highly concordant at **both** time points are flagged
as pre-session coordination (spec §6.2 Reason 2); legitimate
deliberative convergence — dispersed at straw time, aligned at
final time — is NOT flagged. Suspected coalitions are expanded
as connected components over flagged pairs.

Query parameters allow operator override of the default
thresholds (τ concordance 0.85, Jaccard 0.8, top-3).

by ``GET /missions/{mission_id}/petitions/status`` flips to
``triggered: true`` and a new EVALUATE session may be opened.

Spec §9.14 — Speaker re-opens a fresh RANK session after a
first quorum miss. Un-rejects every proposal previously marked

Authority: Speaker clerk only.

Spec §10.5 — Amendment → re-ratify path.

When Constitutional Review returns FAILED, the bill cannot simply be
re-codified: agents must re-vote on the amended DAG so the structural
change is democratically ratified (spec §10.5: *"re-run Ratification on
amendment, not bypass"*). This endpoint:

1. Requires the proposal's most recent review to carry verdict FAILED.
2. Caps total amendments at ``max_codification_retries`` (default 2).
3. Validates the amended DAG with the same Stage-1 rules.
4. Moves the proposal from WINNER back to SHORTLISTED, deletes the
   failed review, and opens a fresh RANK session so agents can vote.

Authority: Speaker clerk only (§4.1 — Speaker authors the DAG). The
``speaker`` role's authority envelope carries ``amend_proposal``.

Spec §Stage 2d → §Stage 3 handoff — Speaker Clerk locks PoP
tiers on every leaf *after* the Stage 2c structured discussion
and *before* the Stage 3 ranked vote. Voters see the tier on the
ballot and can factor it into their ranking.

Authority: Speaker clerk only. ``speaker`` envelope carries
``assign_pop_tier``.

Spec §12.7 — when Stage 6 returns MISMATCH, re-emit the
canonical envelope (up to ``max_codification_retries`` times)
before escalating to the §10.5 amendment path.

Authority: Codifier clerk only — the Codifier owns envelope
instantiation per §11.3 bounded-authority envelope.

Deliberation Stage 5 — Codification.

The Codifier translates the ratified proposal DAG into a formal
specification and instantiates it as a smart contract. Today the
instantiation is mocked: we canonicalise the DAG to JSON and hash
it with SHA-256 (per Frank's "blockchain → placeholder" rule).

Pre-requires: Constitutional Review must already be PASSED.

record a Regulator's signature (and vice versa).

single endpoint instead of re-deriving state from several places. All
field names are camelCase (serialized via alias) to match the frontend
contract.

``status`` derivation:
- ``"active"``  — agent is ACTIVE (registration confirmed on-chain).
- ``"failed"``  — agent still CREATED and a prior confirm attempt failed
  (``failureReason`` populated).
- ``"queued"``  — agent still CREATED with no failure; awaiting signature
  submission / on-chain confirmation.

``"pending"`` and ``"mined"`` are reserved for a future asynchronous
confirmation flow (register tx broadcast but not yet mined); the current
confirm path is synchronous so those states are not emitted yet.
